name: Malakar Nightvein
title: The Dark Lord of Shadowfall
description: A tall, gaunt figure draped in a flowing mantle of living darkness, his eyes glowing crimson beneath a horned helm. His voice is a whisper of dread, yet it carries like a thunderclap in the hearts of his foes.

lineage: Born of forbidden blood beneath the Eclipse Convergence
Allegedly sired by a fallen star and a mortal sorceress

notable_events.event: Raised the Obsidian Citadel from the ashes of the Blackened Vale
Shrouded the Kingdom of Aranthia in perpetual twilight

personality_traits: Driven by an insatiable hunger for power
Commands fear through presence rather than words

inventory.name: Amulet of Baneheart
inventory.description: A black gemstone pendant pulsating with malevolent energy, fueling Malakar’s dark sorceries.

inventory.name: Shadowrend Blade
inventory.description: A jagged longsword forged from void-metal, capable of slicing through both armor and soul.
